label: 2023年12月 · 第3套
title: 2023年12月六级作文（第3套）
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society." You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
sentence: With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society.
theme: 老年人经验的社会价值
outline: 承接首句并把“客套”转为事实判断：忽视长者等于浪费人才。
并列举例：退休教师支教、工程师带徒、祖辈传承家庭与手艺。
指出这些贡献的核心是不可替代的判断力与耐心。
提出发挥价值所需条件（弹性工时、无障碍环境、数字培训），结尾写代际双赢。

expressions.en: This is not mere courtesy but a statement of fact: ...
expressions.zh: not ... but 把客套话升级为事实判断，开头立论有力。

expressions.en: Examples are everywhere once we look for them.
expressions.zh: 过渡句，自然引出并列例子，避免生硬罗列。

expressions.en: What makes these contributions special is judgement, which no textbook can supply.
expressions.zh: What 主语从句 + 非限定定语从句，点出不可替代性。

expressions.en: Of course, older volunteers need suitable conditions, otherwise good intentions may be blocked by a single app.
expressions.zh: otherwise 引出反面后果，讨论政策与条件类话题很实用。

expressions.en: When generations work side by side, the old gain purpose and the young gain guidance.
expressions.zh: When 条件 + 对称结构，结尾写双赢局面。

words.meaning: 老年人、长者，比 old people 更礼貌
导师、带教者，也可作动词表示指导
代际之间的，如 intergenerational cooperation
智慧，强调经验沉淀出的判断力
志愿者；作动词表示自愿服务

sample:
With their valuable skills and experience, elderly people can continue to make significant contributions to society. This is not mere courtesy but a statement of fact: a community that ignores its seniors wastes a huge reservoir of talent and patience.

Examples are everywhere once we look for them. Retired teachers volunteer in rural schools and lift pupils who have fallen behind; seasoned engineers return as mentors and save young teams from costly mistakes; grandparents hold families together and pass on crafts, recipes and local history. What makes these contributions special is judgement, which no textbook can supply. Their patience is also a kind of capital that money cannot buy. Of course, older volunteers need suitable conditions: flexible hours, accessible workplaces and basic digital training, otherwise good intentions may be blocked by a single app. Providing such support is far cheaper than losing their wisdom.

In conclusion, ageing should be viewed as a resource rather than a burden. When generations work side by side, the old gain purpose and the young gain guidance, and society as a whole moves forward.
sample_zh: 范文先立论、再举例、最后提条件。首段承接首句后把客套话转为事实判断：忽视长者的社会浪费了大量人才与耐心。主体段用退休教师下乡支教、资深工程师回聘带徒、祖辈维系家庭并传承手艺三例说明经验的价值，指出核心是可贵的判断力；随后笔锋一转谈条件：弹性工时、无障碍环境、数字培训。结尾把老龄化看作资源。

label: 2023年12月 · 第2套

directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence." You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
sentence: Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence.
theme: 给孩子自由以培养独立性
outline: 承接首句并评价：这一观念转变来得及时，过度保护反而养出脆弱的孩子。
说明机制：判断力只能通过实践生长，小失败是廉价的课程。
用孩子收拾行李、自主选兴趣两例说明自主带来的自信积累。
让步处理安全担忧：自由不等于放任，应设边界、留决定权。

expressions.en: This change of attitude is long overdue, for overprotection, however well intended, often produces ...
expressions.zh: for 表原因 + however well intended 让步插入语，评价某种做法。

expressions.en: The logic behind freedom is simple: judgement grows only through practice.
expressions.zh: The logic behind ... is simple 引出机制解释，简洁有力。

expressions.en: Small failures are cheap lessons, and each small success adds a layer of self-belief.
expressions.zh: 对仗句，把失败与成功都写成成长资源，适合论证段收尾。

expressions.en: Of course, freedom does not mean neglect.
expressions.zh: Of course 让步，先挡回反驳，随后补上边界条件。

expressions.en: In a word, the best gift parents can give is not a ready-made road but the confidence to walk alone.
expressions.zh: not ... but 对比 + 比喻，用于结尾升华。

words.meaning: 过度保护，父母包办一切的典型表现
独立性，foster independence 即培养独立性
自信、对自身能力的信念
边界、限度，set boundaries 即设定界限
自主性，指自己做决定的空间

sample:
Nowadays parents are increasingly aware that allowing kids more freedom to explore and learn on their own helps foster their independence and boost their confidence. This change of attitude is long overdue, for overprotection, however well intended, often produces fragile young adults who panic at the first difficulty.

The logic behind freedom is simple: judgement grows only through practice. A child who is permitted to pack his own bag for a trip may forget a raincoat, but next time he will check the weather himself. A girl who chooses her own hobby, even a strange one, learns to explain her preference and defend her choice. Small failures are cheap lessons, and each small success adds a layer of self-belief. Of course, freedom does not mean neglect. Parents should set clear limits on safety and values while leaving daily decisions to the child, so that guidance replaces control.

In a word, the best gift parents can give is not a ready-made road but the confidence to walk alone. Children raised this way will meet an uncertain future with curiosity rather than fear.
sample_zh: 范文围绕“自由如何长出独立与自信”展开。首段承接首句后评价这一转变来得及时，指出过度保护会养出经不起挫折的年轻人。主体段先讲机制：判断力只能靠实践生长，用孩子自己收拾行李、自主选择兴趣两例说明小失败是廉价课程；再以让步方式处理安全顾虑，强调自由不等于放任。结尾以“给路不如给走路的信心”收束。

label: 2023年12月 · 第1套
title: 2023年12月六级作文（第1套）
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject." You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
sentence: As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject.
theme: 打好基础是学好学科的前提
outline: 承接首句点明基础的重要性，以建筑地基类比强化印象。
提出核心判断：高级知识是基础概念的重组，缺基础者只能死记。
用医学生、程序员两个例子说明无法迁移知识的后果，并补充基础训练培养习惯。
给出具体做法（复习定义、重画图表、口头讲清原理），收束于“由浅入深”。

expressions.en: Foundations may look unglamorous, yet they quietly decide how far a learner can finally go.
expressions.zh: may ... yet 让步转折，评价基础的作用，可套用于任何“打基础”话题。

expressions.en: Advanced knowledge, in fact, is nothing more than a recombination of elementary ideas.
expressions.zh: nothing more than 把“高深”还原为“基础组合”，降低理解门槛。

expressions.en: A student who skips anatomy will struggle to read a scan.
expressions.zh: 定语从句 + will struggle to，写缺少基础的直接后果。

expressions.en: Such learners may pass a test by memorizing formulas, but they cannot transfer their knowledge to a new problem.
expressions.zh: may ... but cannot 对比：表面过关与真正会用之间的差距。

expressions.en: Hence students should resist the temptation to run before they can walk.
expressions.zh: Hence 引出建议，run before one can walk 是形象习语。

words.meaning: 基础、根基，lay a solid foundation 即打牢基础
基本知识、基本原理，常作复数
解剖学，医学专业的基础课程
知识迁移，把所学用到新问题上
系统的、有条理的，形容学习方式

sample:
As is known to all, gaining a sound knowledge of the basics is of vital importance for students to master an academic subject. Foundations may look unglamorous, yet they quietly decide how far a learner can finally go. A building rises according to the depth of its base, and learning obeys the same rule.

Advanced knowledge, in fact, is nothing more than a recombination of elementary ideas. A medical student who skips anatomy will struggle to read a scan; a programmer who ignores logic will copy code without knowing why it works. Such learners may pass a test by memorizing formulas, but they cannot transfer their knowledge to a new problem. Besides, the basics train habits as well as memory. Working through fundamental exercises patiently teaches accuracy, order and persistence, all of which matter in later research.

Hence students should resist the temptation to run before they can walk. Reviewing definitions, redrawing a chart and explaining a principle in plain words are humble tasks, but they turn a shaky start into a solid foundation. Mastery, after all, is built from the ground up.
sample_zh: 范文按“重要性—原因—做法”推进。首段承接首句后用建筑地基作类比，指出基础决定最终高度。主体段给出判断：高深知识不过是基础概念的重组，再用医学生跳过解剖学、程序员不懂逻辑两例说明缺基础者只能靠背公式应付考试、无法迁移，并补充基础训练同时培养准确与耐心。结尾提出“先走再跑”。

label: 2023年6月 · 第3套
title: 2023年6月六级作文（第3套）
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument." You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
sentence: When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.
theme: 分歧面前保持理性沟通
outline: 承接首句后提出对比判断：争吵出于本能，理性需要训练。
分析网络环境如何放大对立：隔着屏幕，攻击成本极低。
用室友噪音之争示范：陈述自身处境比贴标签更易换来妥协。
澄清“理性论证”不是放弃立场，并收束为可操作的三种姿态。

expressions.en: Heated quarrel comes naturally to human beings, whereas calm reasoning requires effort.
expressions.zh: whereas 对比两种倾向，一个出于天性、一个需刻意练习，说理有张力。

expressions.en: Suppose two roommates argue over noise at night.
expressions.zh: Suppose 引出假设情景，比 for example 更有代入感。

expressions.en: Shouting 'you are selfish' solves nothing, but explaining 'I have an early class tomorrow' invites sympathy.
expressions.zh: 正反动词对照（solves nothing / invites sympathy），示范沟通方式的差别。

expressions.en: Reasonable argument does not mean surrendering one's view; it means defending it with facts instead of volume.
expressions.zh: not mean ... it means ... 澄清误解，适合定义类段落。

expressions.en: Those who can ... will always find more partners than those who insist on being right.
expressions.zh: Those who 比较句，结尾对比两种态度的高下。

words.meaning: 激烈争吵，heated 表示情绪激动
同理心，指理解他人处境的能力
误解，clarify misunderstandings 即消除误会
理性说服，靠证据而非情绪
礼貌、文明举止，公共讨论中的重要品质

sample:
When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. Heated quarrel comes naturally to human beings, whereas calm reasoning requires effort; yet only the latter moves us forward. Learning to disagree well is therefore a life skill worth practising.

The internet has made the temptation stronger. Behind a screen, people type insults within seconds and rarely meet the person they attack. Face to face, however, discussion follows a gentler logic. Suppose two roommates argue over noise at night. Shouting 'you are selfish' solves nothing, but explaining 'I have an early class tomorrow' invites sympathy and a compromise. Reasonable argument does not mean surrendering one's view; it means defending it with facts instead of volume. Even when complete agreement is impossible, we can still clarify misunderstandings and narrow the distance between us.

To sum up, a disagreement is a test of our maturity. Those who can listen patiently, present evidence calmly and accept a fair conclusion will always find more partners than those who insist on being right.
sample_zh: 本篇与第 2 套同一首句，但换角度切入网络时代的分歧处理。首段承接首句后指出争吵是天性、冷静推理需练习，而只有后者推动进步。主体段对比屏幕后的秒速对骂与面对面的温和逻辑，用室友夜间噪音之争示范“贴标签”与“讲自身处境”的不同结果，并澄清理性争论不等于放弃立场。结尾以“分歧是成熟度的考试”作结。

label: 2023年6月 · 第2套
title: 2023年6月六级作文（第2套）
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument." You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).
sentence: When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument.
theme: 用理性讨论化解分歧
outline: 承接首句立论：分歧源于视角不同，本身并非坏事。
指出常见误区：把讨论当成争胜负，导致问题失焦、双方更对立。
以小组作业为例，说明倾听与查证如何带来双方都想不到的方案。
结论落到“论证的目的是理解而非取胜”，给出平静理性的态度准则。

expressions.en: Disagreement itself is not a misfortune; it simply proves that ...
expressions.zh: 分号转折句，先消除顾虑再重新定义分歧，适合开头破题。

expressions.en: What matters is how we handle it.
expressions.zh: What matters is ... 主语从句，把讨论焦点从现象转到方法。

expressions.en: Once voices rise and labels replace reasons, the original question is forgotten.
expressions.zh: Once 引导条件，描写争吵升级的连锁后果。

expressions.en: Consider a group project in which two members disagreed about the research method.
expressions.zh: Consider 引出例子的固定句式，后接 in which 补细节。

expressions.en: In short, the purpose of argument is understanding, not victory.
expressions.zh: In short 收束 + not 对比，给全文一个定义式结论。

words.meaning: 不同意见，比 different ideas 更正式
共同点、共识，reach common ground 即达成共识
相互尊重，讨论类话题的常见论点
建设性对话，强调能推动问题解决
妥协、折中方案，可作名词也可作动词

sample:
When faced with differing opinions,we should try to reach agreement through friendly discussion and reasonable argument. Disagreement itself is not a misfortune; it simply proves that people see the same issue from different angles. What matters is how we handle it. A team that never disagrees is usually a team that has stopped thinking.

Unfortunately, many of us are tempted to win a debate rather than to solve a problem. Once voices rise and labels replace reasons, the original question is forgotten and both sides leave angrier than before. Friendly discussion works differently. It begins with listening, proceeds by examining evidence, and ends with a solution that neither side could have reached alone. Consider a group project in which two members disagreed about the research method. Instead of insisting on their own plan, they spent an evening comparing data and eventually combined both approaches, which produced the best report in the class.

In short, the purpose of argument is understanding, not victory. If we keep our tone calm and our minds open, differences of opinion will turn into opportunities for better decisions.
sample_zh: 本文围绕“如何对待分歧”展开。首段承接首句后提出分歧本身不是坏事，关键在于处理方式。主体段先批评争胜而非解决问题的倾向，说明争吵让原问题失焦；接着正面阐述友好讨论的逻辑——倾听、查证、共同求解，并以小组作业两人合并两种研究方法取得最佳报告为例支撑。结尾把论证目的界定为理解而非取胜。

sentence: Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health.
theme: 心理健康与身体健康并重
outline: 承接首句点题：心理健康长期被忽略，需要与身体健康同等对待。
说明忽视心理健康的代价，并用学生、职场人的例子具体化。
让步承认锻炼身体不可替代，进而论证身心互为支撑。
提出日常可行的做法（坦言压力、及时求助、留出休息），结尾强调两者并重。

expressions.en: Admittedly, ... is indispensable, but the two are not rivals; they reinforce each other.
expressions.zh: 让步+辩证：先承认对方合理，再指出互补关系，适合“两个都很重要”类题目。

expressions.en: Left unattended, such pressure quietly erodes memory, concentration and even immunity.
expressions.zh: 过去分词短语作状语，写危害的递进后果，比 if we ignore it 更书面。

expressions.en: A sound mind is the foundation on which every other achievement rests.
expressions.zh: 定语从句点题句，可放段末或结尾，强调根基作用。

expressions.en: Instead of treating mental care as an emergency, we should make it routine.
expressions.zh: Instead of 对比句式，用于提出从被动应对转向日常习惯的建议。

expressions.en: Only when the two kinds of health are valued together can we call ourselves truly well.
expressions.zh: Only when 置句首引起部分倒装，结尾强调必要条件。

words.meaning: 心理健康，指情绪与心理层面的良好状态
焦虑，考试与就业压力场景的高频词
免疫力，可用来论证情绪与身体相互影响
身心耗竭、职业倦怠，形容长期过劳后的状态
情绪韧性，指承受挫折后恢复的能力

sample:
Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. For years we tended to measure health by laboratory reports and body weight, overlooking the invisible strain inside. This imbalance deserves correction, because a sound mind is the foundation on which every other achievement rests.

The damage of neglect is easy to see. A student who cannot sleep before an examination, or an employee who feels empty despite a decent salary, may appear perfectly healthy in a medical check-up. Left unattended, such pressure quietly erodes memory, concentration and even immunity. Admittedly, physical fitness is indispensable, but the body and the mind are not rivals; they reinforce each other. Regular exercise relieves anxiety, while emotional calm makes it easier to keep healthy habits alive.

Therefore, we should treat mental care as routine rather than emergency. Talking openly about stress, seeking professional help when necessary and setting aside time for rest are simple steps that everyone can take. Only when the two kinds of health are valued together can we call ourselves truly well.
sample_zh: 范文抓住“同等重要”这一判断。首段承接首句，指出过去只凭体检报告判断健康的偏差，提出健全心智是其他成就的基础。主体段用学生考前失眠、白领收入体面却内心空虚两个现象说明忽视代价，再以让步句承认身体锻炼不可或缺，随即指出二者互为支撑。结尾给出可操作建议并回扣开头，首尾闭环。
